item.title: Steve Jobs and Cray-1 to be featured on 2026 American Innovations $1 coin
Upcoming Rust language features for kernel development
item.description:
📝 Many people have remarked that the development of new language features in Rust can be quite slow, Mandry said. Ultimately, Miguel Ojeda told Mandry that the priority should be on stabilizing the unstable language features that Rust for Linux currently uses, followed by language features that would change how the project structures its code, followed by everything else. So the most general possible signature for the field projection operation would be something like this, Lossin said: That is, given some pointer type that wraps a structure and must be valid for lifetime a, projecting a field gives a (possibly different) output pointer type wrapping a field of that structure, valid for the same lifetime.
🔗 Read more: https://lwn.net/Articles/1039073/

item.title: Waymo is bringing autonomous, driverless ride-hailing to London in 2026
item.description:
📝 Waymo Waymo is bringing fully autonomous, driverless ride-hailing to London in 2026 Damien Wilde | Oct 15 2025 - 5:23 am PT 3 Comments Screenshot Waymo has officially announced plans to launch its fully autonomous ride-hailing service in London, UK, starting in 2026. Waymo has already logged over one hundred million fully autonomous miles on U. ” Waymo is will be sharing more details on the expansion to London and more UK news on the firm’s official blog.
